description:
src/methods/metadata.rs:56 (metadata_get) and :204 (metadata_set) — the public method signatures directly use jmap_metadata_types::Metadata as the generic parameter on response types:

    pub async fn metadata_get(…)
        -> Result<GetResponse<jmap_metadata_types::Metadata>, jmap_base_client::ClientError>

    pub async fn metadata_set(…)
        -> Result<SetResponse<jmap_metadata_types::Metadata>, jmap_base_client::ClientError>

This is a structural major-version pin to jmap-metadata-types — equivalent in risk shape to the pub-use re-exports wzq9.21 calls out. A major version bump of jmap-metadata-types (e.g. a breaking change to the Annotation/ImapMetadata/WebDavMetadata wire shape, or a non-additive change to the Metadata enum that even #[non_exhaustive] cannot mask) bumps this crate's major version too.

wzq9.21 enumerates jmap-types (re-exports: AddedItem, ChangesResponse, GetResponse, etc., and Session as a parameter) and jmap-base-client (re-export: ClientError; parameter: Session) as the two pinned-major surfaces. It does NOT name jmap-metadata-types. A fix-author addressing wzq9.21 (e.g. by adding a README "Gotchas" note about the upstream major-version dependency) could miss the metadata-types pin entirely — they would document a partial truth.

Worse: a downstream that depends on both jmap-metadata-client AND jmap-metadata-types directly (e.g. to use MetadataFilterCondition for filter construction, since this crate accepts serde_json::Value for filter — see wzq9.6, wzq9.24) will see two copies of jmap-metadata-types in the crate graph if the minor versions diverge and the workspace ships uncoordinated. The Metadata returned by metadata_get will then have a type-id from one copy and the caller's typed filter shapes from the other — type-system rejection at the boundary with no obvious diagnostic.

This finding extends wzq9.21's enumeration. Same mitigation menu applies (pin in Cargo.toml, document in README, accept the risk).

Workspace-wide: every extension-client has a per-extension-types crate in its return-type generics. Propagate from canonical.

Cross-ref: wzq9.21, wzq9.6, wzq9.24.
title: jmap_metadata_types::Metadata in public return types locks crate major version (extends wzq9.21)
